about: cwplans knowledge graph: immutable graph versions made by logged operations. See README.md.

facts.title: Cited facts about Canary Wharf and the Docklands structures
facts.licence: facts with short quotes from cited pages (crawl rule of 2026-10-03, scoping); each fact names its source URL

buildings.title: Registry buildings of the Canary Wharf box (cwb- ids): names, positions, outlines, levels, height, postcodes, identifiers
buildings.licence: derived from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0), Wikidata (CC0), OS Open UPRN/USRN/TOID ids (OGL)

occupants.title: Occupants of the registry buildings: shops, food and drink, services, offices, with role, level, opening hours and links
occupants.licence: joined from OSM (ODbL), FSA ratings (OGL), Canary Wharf Group directory (crawl rule, scoping), brand and register sources named per occupant in the registry

cwg.title: Canary Wharf Group directory: typed occupants, malls, levels, page dates and weekly opening hours
cwg.licence: Canary Wharf Group pages as archived by the Internet Archive; crawl rule of 2026-10-03, scoping only

web.title: Canonical schema.org layer from the web harvest (branch cards, weekly hours, organisation cards), all pages merged
web.licence: the publishers' own markup; crawl rule of 2026-10-03, scoping only

coref-iri.title: Same-thing links by key rule "iri" between web descriptions (made by tools/web-coref.mjs)

coref-postcode-name.title: Same-thing links by key rule "postcode-name" between web descriptions (made by tools/web-coref.mjs)

coref-telephone.title: Same-thing links by key rule "telephone" between web descriptions (made by tools/web-coref.mjs)

coref-sameAs.title: Same-thing links by key rule "sameAs" between web descriptions (made by tools/web-coref.mjs)

coref-site-name.title: Same-thing links by key rule "site-name" between web descriptions (made by tools/web-coref.mjs)

mallmap.title: Mall units and facilities (lifts, escalators, ramps, stairs, entrances, toilets, defibrillators and more) from the Living Map data behind map.canarywharf.com
mallmap.licence: Canary Wharf Group / Living Map; archived at the owner's request 2026-10-06 for reference and accessibility design study, scoping only

storeguide.title: Canary Wharf Group store guide (20 July 2026): listed shops, restaurants, cafés, services and office tenants with section and grid squares, read by OCR (tools/cwg-maps-tmi.mjs)
storeguide.licence: Canary Wharf Group; design © Ravenshaw Studios Limited and Paul & Linda Anthony 2026; facts only, scoping

pipeline.title: Provenance of the earlier cwplans pipeline: every tool as a prov:Activity with the files it used and made (pipeline.jsonld), each file tied to its content at this build

meta.title: Descriptions of the graph versions and the current version of each graph name

log.title: The activity log: every operation run on the kgx graphs, its inputs, parameters and outputs
